title: Holy Sect Intelligence
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji saw the coordinates marked on that yellowed blueprint, his pupils constricted sharply—that location was exactly the entrance to the forbidden grounds he had been investigating for three full years.

text.content: The transmission talisman floated in the void, its ethereal blue glow casting Ye Qing's features in alternating light and shadow. Chen Ji stared at the rune, his brow twitching subtly. The Holy Sect's emergency recall orders were issued under only two circumstances—either the Saintess faced mortal peril, or the Holy Sect required core personnel for a major operation. Yet Ye Qing had just concluded an alliance agreement with him, making this recall's timing far too convenient. "They've made their move." Ye Qing's voice was low, her fingertips brushing along the talisman's edge. "It seems the Holy Sect's upper echelons have detected something amiss." Chen Ji did not speak, merely silently committing the talisman's existence to memory—the appearance of this talisman precisely corroborated a previous suspicion of his. The Holy Sect's布局 was far more profound than it appeared on the surface.

Ye Qing held the talisman in her palm, ethereal blue light spilling through her fingers, casting mottled shadows in the dim chamber. Her expression was abnormally calm, as if it were not a death warrant but a battle report whose contents she already knew. "In three days." She spoke casually. "In three days I must return to the Holy Sect headquarters, otherwise they will activate the backup plan." Chen Ji's gaze tightened slightly: "What backup plan?" Ye Qing did not answer directly. Instead, she withdrew a pitch-black token from her sleeve, its surface covered in dense prohibition runes, faintly emitting a chilling surge of spiritual energy. "Do you know why I have never completely freed myself from the Holy Sect's control?" Her voice carried a hint of bitterness. "Because of this Sect Master's Token. It is connected to my soul. Once I exceed the prescribed distance from headquarters, or show any sign of defection..." She paused. "My soul will collapse within a quarter hour."

Chen Ji listened to Ye Qing's narration, his face betraying no emotional fluctuation. His fingers tapped lightly on the wooden table beside him, producing a rhythmic sound. Sect Master's Token, backup plan, soul collapse—these words rapidly combined in his mind into a chilling speculation. The Holy Sect's control over core members was far more brutal than he had imagined. He recalled something Mo Xiansheng had once said: "A true chess master never leaves his pieces any possibility of escape." The Holy Sect's treatment of Ye Qing precisely confirmed this. A Saintess bound by soul prohibitions, no matter how powerful, was merely an advanced puppet. "A three-day deadline." Chen Ji spoke slowly. "Enough for you to do many things." Upon hearing this, a hint of surprise flickered in Ye Qing's eyes. She had expected Chen Ji to probe for more details, or perhaps show some sympathy, never expecting such a... pragmatic response.

dialogue.content: "Before I leave, I must tell you something." Ye Qing took a deep breath, retrieving a stack of yellowed papers and a damaged jade slip from her storage bag. "These are Holy Sect secrets I have been secretly collecting over the years. I originally planned to use them as bargaining chips for my escape, but now... giving them to you may be more valuable." Chen Ji's gaze fell upon the stack of papers, but he did not reach out for them. He merely waited, waiting for Ye Qing to proactively reveal the worth of these items. Ye Qing seemed to have anticipated his reaction, her lips curving slightly upward: "Among them is intelligence regarding the person you have been searching for." She paused, lowering her voice considerably. "Your sister, Chen Nian."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's intelligence is right before you, but Ye Qing clearly has more cards to play. How would you respond at this moment?

choices.description: "Chen Nian's whereabouts are the first priority. Any factor that might delay this process should be eliminated."
choices.risk_hint: "Exposing obsession with one's sister may become a weakness"

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate, reaching out to take the stack of papers. His movement was swift, even carrying a hint of imperceptible urgency. Ye Qing observed all this, a knowing glint flashing in her eyes—so even this man who seemed terrifyingly composed had moments when he could not maintain rationality. The papers unfolded in his hands, line after line of ink coming into view. Chen Ji's breath abruptly halted the moment he saw a certain line, but quickly returned to calm. Only Ye Qing noticed that the knuckles of his fingers gripping the papers had turned slightly white. "..." Chen Ji remained silent for a long time, long enough that Ye Qing thought he would never speak again. "This location," his voice was terrifyingly calm, "are you certain?"

choices.description: "Intelligence is important, but the process of obtaining it is equally crucial. Understanding why Ye Qing is willing to proactively share this information is more important."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain more background information and bargaining chips"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing may think you don't trust her enough"

text.content: Chen Ji did not reach out immediately. His gaze shifted from the stack of papers to Ye Qing's face. "Where did this intelligence come from?" His voice carried no emotional coloring. "Though your position in the Holy Sect is special, obtaining intelligence of this caliber must have come at a considerable cost." Ye Qing was slightly startled, then revealed a meaningful smile. She was not angered by Chen Ji's probing; instead, her eyes held more appreciation. "You really are different from the rumors." She said softly. "No wonder you could pretend to be atrash in the Tianqing Sect for so many years." She placed the papers on the table, slowly returning to her seat. "Since you want to know, I'll tell you from the beginning."

choices.text: "Use the Tianji Record to verify the intelligence's authenticity"
choices.description: "When the authenticity of information is difficult to distinguish, using the Tianji Record to foresee what may happen within the next three hours is the most prudent choice."
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate is extremely precious; casual consumption may lead to fatal consequences"

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fingertips gently gliding over the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve. A familiar sense of weakness rose from his mind, and the power of the Tianji Record was awakened once more. However, just as the vision was about to take shape, Chen Ji's brow suddenly tightened—he saw a blurry figure standing within some dark prison. That figure's features were shrouded in a layer of hazy light fog; no matter how hard he tried, he could not see clearly. Could this be...

Ye Qing gazed at Chen Ji taking the paper, a complex light flickering in her eyes. She could see him forcibly suppressing some emotion, a craving deliberately hidden yet still leaking through. This seemingly flawless man ultimately had an unseverable weakness. She did not disturb him, silently waiting for Chen Ji to digest this information. The secret chamber fell into a brief silence, with only the faint rustle of paper turning. Chen Ji's gaze swept rapidly across the paper's contents, each word seared into his mind like a branding iron. For three years he had secretly investigated his sister's whereabouts, countless times traversing various clues, yet never could touch the truth. And now, a corner of the truth lay before him.

On the yellowed paper was a detailed account of Chen Nian's complete imprisonment. On that rainy night three years ago, an elite squad from the Holy Sect raided the Chen family old residence, forcibly taking the fifteen-year-old Chen Nian. The clan members perished in resistance, with only a few barely escaping. The reason for taking Chen Nian was clearly written on another document marked 'Top Secret' — the Heavenly Fate Key Project. 'Heavenly Fate Key?' Chen Ji's voice was low, 'What does this mean?' Ye Qing took out a miniature spiritual energy projector from the jade slip, projecting a complex light image in the air. The image showed the structure of some formation, and at its center, clearly marked, was a human silhouette. That silhouette was wrapped by dozens of restriction chains, the entire person suspended at the core of a massive formation array. Though the image was blurry, that silhouette's figure bore seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Nian. 'This is the essence of the Heavenly Fate Key Project.' Ye Qing's voice carried a trace of sorrow, 'They intend to use humans as vessels to forcibly pry open the Heavenly Fate Laws.'

Chen Ji stared at that blurry silhouette, his knuckles unconsciously tightening. He recognized that silhouette, even with his face obscured by the restrictions. He could still recognize his sister from that familiar outline. Three years apart, and she had actually endured such torment. 'Specific location.' His voice was terrifyingly calm, 'Where is she being held?' Ye Qing pointed to a corner of the light image, where a secret coordinate was marked. Chen Ji quickly memorized this coordinate while rapidly constructing the complete geographical situation in his mind. This location was at the junction of the three major sect forces, a barren land abandoned by all three parties by mutual agreement. Deep beneath that area existed an entrance to an ancient era forbidden land — one of the three forbidden lands indicated by the Tianji Record Fragment. 'The Holy Sect chose this location,绝非偶然.' Chen Ji said quietly, 'They intend to use the power of the forbidden land to complete the Heavenly Fate Key Project.'

dialogue.content: 'You are very clever, even more clever than I imagined.' Ye Qing shut off the light projection, the secret chamber falling dark again, 'The Holy Sect's Heavenly Fate Key Project has been in preparation for nearly a century. They search nationwide for Heavenly Fate individuals who meet the conditions, imprisoning them in specific formations and gradually extracting their Heavenly Fate power. And your sister Chen Nian is the most special of all the keys — her Heavenly Fate attribute has produced some kind of resonance with the Tianji Record Fragment.' Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Tianji Record Fragment? Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate attribute resonated with the Tianji Record? What did this mean? Ye Qing seemed to see his confusion and continued, 'The Tianji Record is a forbidden object left from ancient times, said to be able to peer into Heavenly Secrets and predict destiny. And your sister's existence may become the key to perfecting the Tianji Record. The Holy Sect has been searching for scattered Tianji Record Fragments across various places, and your sister... is the key they use to activate these fragments.'

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long time. The air in the secret chamber seemed to solidify, with only the distant wind's mournful howl. He remembered the rainy night three years ago when Chen Nian disappeared, his mother's deathbed entrustment, and the countless nights he had spent alone in the Tianqing Sect playing the fool while secretly investigating. All the clues, all the forbearance, all the schemes... converged at this moment into a clear objective. 'How long does the Holy Sect need to complete this project?' he asked, his voice returning to its usual calm. Ye Qing looked at him, a flash of admiration crossing her eyes. This man, upon learning of his closest relative's tragic circumstances, could still maintain such degree of composure. Such temperament alone was worthy of reverence. 'According to the intelligence I've obtained, the Holy Sect plans to activate the final formation array during a celestial phenomenon variation three months from now. At that time, they will simultaneously activate all Heavenly Fate Keys, forcibly prying open the Heavenly Fate Laws.届时...' she paused, 'the entire cultivation world will face a catastrophe.'

choice.prompt: Three months' time window, Chen Nian's imprisoned location is already clear. At this moment, you must make a decision — whether to immediately launch a rescue, or make preparations from the perspective of overall game theory?

choices.description: Three months seems abundant, yet is actually full of variables. Must quickly confirm Chen Nian's specific condition and formulate a meticulous rescue plan.
choices.visible_reward: Strive for rescue time and master the initiative
choices.risk_hint: Reckless action may expose intentions, causing the Holy Sect to accelerate their plan progress

text.content: 'Three months.' Chen Ji stood up and walked to the table in the center of the secret chamber, 'The Holy Sect chose that location to imprison Chen Nian, they must have their considerations. The forbidden land's power, the formation array's arrangement, the guard deployment... do you have intelligence on these?' Ye Qing nodded and took out another jade slip from her storage bag: 'This is the forbidden land deployment map I obtained at the risk of my life. The Holy Sect has arranged at least three layers of defense there. The outermost is a patrol team of twelve Golden Core stage experts, the middle layer is a restriction formation array overseen by three Nascent Soul stage elders, and the inner layer...' her voice turned grave, 'the inner layer is guarded personally by the Holy Sect's Vice Sect Master, a terrifying existence at the Transformation God stage.' After Chen Ji listened, the corner of his mouth slightly lifted, revealing a meaningful smile. 'Transformation God stage... Interesting. It seems the Holy Sect places great importance on this 'key' Chen Nian.'

choices.text: Re-strategize from the perspective of overall game theory
choices.description: Rescuing Chen Nian is固然重要, but the Holy Sect's ambition extends far beyond this. Must fundamentally dismantle their plan, not merely rescue one person.
choices.visible_cost: May cause Chen Nian to suffer more
choices.visible_reward: Fundamentally shake the Holy Sect's foundations

text.content: 'Rescuing Chen Nian is merely the first step.' Chen Ji turned to look at Ye Qing, his eyes radiating profound light, 'The Holy Sect dares such large-scale operations, they must have sufficient trump cards to deal with interference from various forces. We cannot only focus on Chen Nian, but must re-examine this chess game from the entire cultivation world's pattern.' Ye Qing was slightly stunned, then showed an appreciative expression. This man's thinking had indeed not disappointed her. If one merely rescues the person单纯地救人, even if successful it would invite the Holy Sect's frantic revenge. But if one could dismantle the Holy Sect's plans from an overall perspective, that would be the true supreme strategy. 'What do you intend to do?' she asked. Chen Ji slowly walked back to his seat, fingers gently tapping the table: 'First, we need to understand what the Holy Sect's Heavenly Fate Key Project ultimately aims to achieve. Prying open the Heavenly Fate Laws... the ambition behind this far exceeds our imagination.'

choices.text: Parallel dual-line operations, prepare for both possibilities
choices.description: Rescue and overall game theory are not opposing options. Can prepare for rescue while simultaneously deploying pieces targeting other Holy Sect objectives.
choices.visible_cost: Energy dispersed, may fail to achieve perfection on both fronts
choices.visible_reward: Can advance or retreat, not putting all hopes on one path
choices.risk_hint: Dual-line operations require extremely strong resource allocation capabilities, possibly exceeding current capabilities

text.content: 'Parallel dual-line operations.' Chen Ji stated his plan, 'While rescuing Chen Nian, we need to plant more pieces within the Holy Sect to disrupt their other schemes. Only by making the Holy Sect unable to attend to both ends can we have the opportunity to complete our objectives within three months.' Ye Qing pondered for a moment, then slowly nodded. This plan was the most stable, yet also the most complex. It required precise resource allocation and timing control; a single misstep could lead to total failure. 'Where do you intend to start?' she asked. Chen Ji took out a delicate transmission jade talisman from his sleeve, gently rubbing it in his palm: 'I have some... old friends in the three major sects. It's time to contact them.' Ye Qing looked at that jade talisman, a flash of surprise crossing her eyes. This man had played the fool in the Tianqing Sect for so many years — how many hidden pieces had he secretly laid? At this moment, her evaluation of Chen Ji rose another level.

Just as Chen Ji prepared to further elaborate his plan, the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve suddenly grew warm. This anomaly made his heart tighten — the Tianji Record typically only reacts in two situations: when the Foresight Ability is activated, or when there is a power fluctuation related to the Tianji Record in the surroundings. His expression unchanged, he found an excuse to temporarily leave the secret chamber. After confirming no one was around, he took out the fragment to examine it.只见页面边缘浮现出一行若隐若现的文字：'Heavenly Fate Key, Guide of Heavenly Secrets. The chess game is set, who is the Chess Player?' Chen Ji stared at that line of text for a long time. The connection between the Heavenly Fate Key and the Tianji Record was even closer than he imagined. If Chen Nian truly was the key to activating the Tianji Record, then the Holy Sect's purpose in imprisoning her was not merely to pry open the Heavenly Fate Laws — what they wanted was to completely control the power of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: Just at this moment, an aged voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind—one he knew all too well: Mo Xiansheng. "Little one, you've finally traced it this far." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of relief, mixed with no small amount of worry. "Chen Nian's fate is tightly bound to the Tianji Record. This is both her劫数 and your sliver of opportunity. If the Holy Sect's Heavenly Fate Lock Key plan succeeds, not only will the entire cultivation world descend into chaos, but the Tianji Record itself will be completely sealed. At that time, the foresight ability you've relied upon will vanish entirely." Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly: "Then what should I do?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, as if weighing how much to reveal: "The time hasn't come yet—your current strength is insufficient to directly oppose the Holy Sect. But you're walking the right path. That demonic path saintess is a crucial piece in your chess game. Use her well, but also be careful... the Holy Sect's eyes are everywhere."

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's reminder made Chen Ji realize that Ye Qing might be a double-edged sword. In your subsequent actions, how will you position the cooperative relationship with Ye Qing?

choices.description: Since you've decided to ally with Ye Qing, grant her the maximum level of trust and let her participate in core decision-making.

choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's loyalty still has uncertainty

text.content: When Chen Ji returned to the secret chamber, Ye Qing was quietly waiting for him. Her gaze lingered on Chen Ji's face for a moment, as if sensing something, but she didn't ask. Chen Ji sat down across from her and took a jade slip from his sleeve, handing it to her. "This is part of my layout over these three years, including the hidden pieces I've planted in the Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, and other demonic path forces." Ye Qing took the jade slip and probed it with her divine sense, then revealed a shocked expression. The amount of information recorded within exceeded her imagination—this man who appeared to be merely a Tianqing Sect servant disciple had, without anyone noticing, woven a vast intelligence network covering the entire cultivation world. "You..." She was momentarily at a loss for words. Chen Ji said calmly: "Since we've decided to cooperate, there's no need to hold back. Next, let's discuss the action plan together."

text.content: When Chen Ji returned to the secret chamber, he only disclosed the most basic information needed for cooperation with Ye Qing in the jade slip. He told Ye Qing some insignificant intelligence; the real core layout remained hidden in his own mind. Ye Qing glanced at the jade slip and her lips curved slightly upward. She showed no dissatisfaction; instead, there was a new appreciation in her eyes. "You're very cautious." She said calmly, "That's good. In this world, those who trust others lightly usually die the fastest." Chen Ji responded coolly: "Mutually." The two exchanged a glance and smiled—all that needed to be said was understood. During the subsequent discussion, they established a preliminary cooperation framework: Ye Qing would be responsible for providing intelligence from within the Holy Sect, while Chen Ji would handle peripheral layout and resource allocation. As for more detailed plans, adjustments would be made based on how the situation developed.

text.content: On the surface, Chen Ji discussed a cooperation framework with Ye Qing, but in his heart, he was actually calculating a completely different plan. He needed Ye Qing's intelligence and her demonic path identity as cover, but he would never let her know his ultimate goal. During the subsequent conversation, he deliberately guided the direction of topics, making Ye Qing believe their cooperation was limited to rescuing Chen Nian. And his true layout—the hidden pieces scattered throughout the cultivation world, the yet-to-be-activated backup plans—all remained deep in his heart. Ye Qing seemed to sense something, but she didn't point it out. In this world of deception, who doesn't have their own secrets?

The discussion lasted a full hour. When the stone door of the secret chamber opened again, the sky outside had already begun to lighten slightly. Dawn light filtered through the mountain mist, shrouding the entire Tianqing Sect in a hazy golden glow. Ye Qing stood at the chamber door, glancing back at Chen Ji. "I must return to the Holy Sect in three days." Her voice carried a complex emotion. "Before then, I'll give you all the intelligence I've collected." Chen Ji nodded: "Be careful on the road. The Holy Sect's eyes are everywhere—don't let them discover anything unusual." Ye Qing's lips curved slightly: "You're more nervous than I am. Don't worry, I've played the obedient saintess in the Holy Sect for over a decade—I have that much skill." She turned to leave but suddenly stopped. "By the way, there's one more thing I almost forgot to tell you." She lowered her voice. "I saw a name in the Holy Sect intelligence—Ling Yuan." Chen Ji's gaze instantly sharpened. Ye Qing continued: "The former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect seems to have some secret connection with the Holy Sect. I don't yet know his specific identity and purpose, but you'd better be careful of this person." With that, her figure turned into black mist and vanished into the dawn light.

After Ye Qing left, Chen Ji stood alone at the chamber door, the morning wind brushing past his robes, bringing a chill. Ling Yuan—that old Sect Master who had always shown him "special care" at Tianqing Sect, was actually connected to the Holy Sect. This news didn't surprise Chen Ji. In fact, he had sensed long ago that Ling Yuan's motives for approaching him weren't pure—he just hadn't expected the water behind this to run so deep. The previous generation's candidate for the Tianji Record inheritance... resentful after being "skipped" by the Tianji Record... now colluding with the Holy Sect. Chen Ji quietly connected these pieces in his mind, and a terrifying conjecture gradually took shape. Perhaps Ling Yuan's "care" for him had been a carefully designed trap from the very beginning. Had Ling Yuan already noticed the layout Chen Ji had built over the years at Tianqing Sect? A chill rose up Chen Ji's back. He realized the situation he faced was even more complex than he'd imagined. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key plan, the Holy Sect's ambitions, Ling Yuan's conspiracy... all the clues pointed in one direction: the players in this chess game were by no means limited to the Holy Sect alone.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, calming the turmoil in his heart. No matter how complex the situation, he would never back down. Three years ago, he had lost everything. For three years, he had endured and hidden, doing everything for this very moment. Chen Nian was still waiting for him—she was his only kin left in this world. He turned and walked back into the secret chamber, taking out the Tianji Record Fragment. The text on the fragment remained faint and elusive, emanating an ancient and mysterious aura. Chen Ji gazed at that line of characters: Heavenly Fate Lock Key, Guide to Heavenly Secrets. The chess game is set—who holds the pieces? He murmured softly: "Who holds the pieces?" A meaningful smile appeared at the corner of his lips. "This game has only just begun." The dawn light poured into the secret chamber, stretching Chen Ji's shadow long. He gripped the fragment tightly, his eyes burning with unprecedented determination. No matter how treacherous the path ahead, he would walk it step by step. Because at the end of that road, someone was waiting for him.
